coverage: Covered live: all 4 local containers (unit states, transport /health, 7 days of transport journals, discovery /bootstrap, /metrics, /registry/shapes, env keys classified without printing values) plus the remote syzygy-hub droplet 104.236.0.175 (bootstrap, metrics, /vessels lookups, TCP reachability). Also read the node-2 pool (18 federationVerificationReport sweeps and the latest verdicts), the node-1 gap store (112 federation-related gaps), all 5 federation openspec changes (task counts and proposals), git history of scripts/substrate/federation-relay (about 45 commits) and repos/libp2p-federation-transport (11), the network-demo report, and the provenance of .relay-pub-key.protobuf (it is actually a private key; peer id derived; the operator transcript that created it was found). Not covered: per-row contents of the node-1/node-2 vesselRegistry (the in-container-key read was refused by the permission classifier, so unauthenticated surfaces were used instead); success/failure of individual syzygy p2p forwards (the logs carry no status); the obsidian-vessel federation-sidecar runtime; the caller that polls federation-transport-vessel@local-dev-spoke on node 1 (not identified).

problems.symptom: The production nodes are not on any p2p overlay: node 1 has no transport/relay (unit disabled, relay not installed), and node 2's transport is direct-only with 0 connections, no multiaddr, and the hub mirror skipped

principles: Measure federation between the production nodes, from a foreign vantage; an in-container oracle whose peers are absent must fail, not report undecidable
A lab demo in throwaway containers is not deployment: check the production topology (node 1 standalone, node 2 compute) before claiming a capability
Federation must not be enabled by boot-time env presence; the profile that makes a node a hub must be the thing that brings up relay+transport, and it must survive recreate
HTTP host pinning (host.containers.internal) masquerades as federation; count what actually crosses over the overlay
Evidence text in auto-filed gaps must be measured per sweep, never a frozen template that outlives the fix
Alias invented shape names to the served shape instead of closing capability gaps one name at a time
Keys and build output never belong in the source tree; default key paths must point to the volume
